data.meta_desc: Doon Business School, Dehraduns leading institute for MBA, BBA, IPM & B.Com programs. Industry-focused education, expert faculty,

data.details:
DBS has a legacy of 18 years of excellence in management education.

As a premier business school, DBS pioneers in the integration of technology and AI across all of its programs and curriculum, at par with international educational benchmarks. DBS ensures its students are agile, future-ready leaders equipped to excel in the global business landscape

Since the inception of Doon Business School, it has maintained a 100% placement record, with over 350 companies visiting every year. Students recover their investment through strong starting packages. Recruiters include leading consulting firms (Deloitte, Grant Thornton, EY), major IT companies (Infosys, Mahindra tech, HCLTech), national and international banks (ANZ, DBS, Axis Bank), top FMCG brands (Unilever, ITC Limited, Mother Dairy), and key players across cement (ACC Cement, Adani Cement, UltraTech) Cement and construction companies (Asian Paints, Somany, Johnson Tiles) and many more.

What truly sets Doon Business School apart is its commitment to embedding globally benchmarked certification into every facet of the student’s journey.

This innovation stays connected to real industry needs through robust collaborations with giants such as SAP, SAS, and HCLTech. These partnerships help our graduates become industry-ready professionals, strengthened by a suite of value-added certifications that include SAP Global, SAS Global, Agile and Scrum, AI & ML, Power BI, NISM, ACCA, Alteryx, and many more.

Our future-focused approach provides students with direct, hands-on exposure to agentic AI systems, crypto, and blockchain applications and Capital Markets, cultivating practical mastery in high-demand fields like digital assets, corporate finance, and trading.

Integrating super-specialisation into the School’s flagship programs, such as the MBA, adds a whole new dimension to learning. Other offerings, including BBA, B.Com, and the integrated BBA+MBA, are equally innovative and designed to prepare students for the future.

Our extensive network of international academic pathways, with over 50 university partnerships across 20+ countries, offers unmatched opportunities for global exposure and professional growth.

Immersion One week, two weeks, one month and two months available to our aspiring students. Besides immersion programs semester abroad program, and one year of study in partner institutions is also available. Partner institutions include IE Business School, EM Normandie Business School, Singapore Management School, Bocconi University, and many more.
data.heading: What makes Doon Business School Unique?
data.readmore:
• Industry-aligned curriculum : The school's curriculum is designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge demanded by today's dynamic business environment. Regular industry updates and case studies ensure that students are well-prepared for the challenges and opportunities that lie ahead.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit : The school nurtures entrepreneurial spirit among its students, encouraging them to develop innovative ideas and pursue their business aspirations. Dedicated entrepreneurship programs and mentorship opportunities provide the necessary support and guidance for aspiring entrepreneurs.
  • Experiential learning : The School emphasises experiential learning, providing students with hands-on opportunities to apply their knowledge in real-world settings. Internships, industry projects, and simulations are integral components of the learning experience.
  • Global outlook : The School fosters a global perspective, preparing students to navigate the complexities of the international business arena. Cross-cultural experiences and international collaborations are encouraged to broaden students' horizons and enhance their adaptability.
